variantPolicy.normalizationRule: Classify a known variant as variantAllowed when its orthodox form appears in the active legal pool.

legalStatusPolicy.allowed: Orthodox Hanja appears in the active legal pool.
legalStatusPolicy.variantAllowed: Input Hanja is a known variant and the normalized orthodox Hanja appears in the active legal pool.
legalStatusPolicy.hangulOnly: No Hanja code point is present; name remains eligible for Hangul-only handling.
legalStatusPolicy.unknown: The active curated pool is intentionally non-definitive, or official confirmation has not yet been extracted.
legalStatusPolicy.notAllowed: The definitive full pool does not contain the normalized Hanja.

notes: The current local full pool keeps the 9,495 mirror entries available for opt-in lookup.
The official 9,389 denominator is recorded from T5 official sources.
The +106 mirror delta remains unknown until the official Appendix 1/2 glyph tables are fully machine-extracted or each extra entry is T5-confirmed.
